import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        raise EOFError("No input token")
    s = data[0]
    ans = 0
    count = 1
    for i in range(1, len(s)):
        if s[i] == s[i-1]:
            count += 1
        else:
            if count % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
            count = 1
    if count % 2 == 0:
        ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
